subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: Should this QA migration include the production Gateway admission and expanded Plugin SDK runtime contracts, or should those changes be split into separately owned PRs?
rationale: The migration itself is well-proven, but the broader production and public-contract surfaces cross owner boundaries and cannot be accepted solely from QA parity evidence.

options.title: Split production scope
options.body: Land the QA-owned migration separately and move Gateway admission or independently useful SDK changes into owner-scoped PRs with focused proof.

options.title: Approve combined scope
options.body: Keep the current stack together only after Gateway and Plugin SDK owners approve the exact design and repository security authorizes the dependency graph.

recommendation.title: Split production scope
recommendation.body: Land the QA-owned migration separately and move Gateway admission or independently useful SDK changes into owner-scoped PRs with focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current stacked design and is best positioned to narrow it or provide the cross-surface necessity argument for owner approval.
